packflow-2M.description: Smallest base flow-matching model (d_model=160-ish). Tables 1/2 size sweep.

packflow-20M.description: Mid-size base flow-matching model. Tables 1/2 size sweep.

packflow-ddp.description: 60M DDP-trained base model. The canonical 60M used in the main tables and as the GRPO base.

packflow-pa.description: Preference-aligned (PA) model: GRPO finetune of packflow-ddp with energy+force reward at lambda=1.0 (experiment E025). Used for Figure 4 and Figure 5.
